rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００９＿００１This exam is "Rescue." It tests￥whether you can act quickly in a￥disaster.＝＠００９＿００２At the back of the room is a￥dummy standing in for someone￥who needs rescuing.
＊Narusawa＊＠００９＿００３It may be a dummy, but it weighs￥as much as a real person.＝＠００９＿００４It'll be tough for the weaker￥ones, but do your best and get￥it out safely.
